title: Areas of Similar Triangles — Triangles
hook: Let's explore Areas of Similar Triangles from the chapter on Triangles. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Areas of Similar Triangles The ratio of areas of two similar triangles equals the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides (or altitudes, or medians). Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Area(△ABC)/Area(△DEF) = (AB/DE)² = (BC/EF)² = (CA/FD)²
💡 Also equals (altitude₁/altitude₂)² and (median₁/median₂)²
💡 If sides are in ratio k:1, areas are in ratio k²:1
💡 Useful for finding areas without knowing all dimensions
